Student.title: Student
Student.description: Represents a student and their parent's name.

parentName.description: The name of the parent or guardian.

ContributionRequest.title: ContributionRequest
ContributionRequest.description: Represents a request for a financial contribution.

title.description: The title of the contribution request.

description.description: A description of the contribution request.

createdAt.description: The date the request was created. Should be a server timestamp.

Contribution.title: Contribution
Contribution.description: Represents a single contribution made by a student.

studentId.description: The ID of the student making the contribution.

studentName.description: The name of the student making the contribution.

requestId.description: The ID of the contribution request this is for.

requestTitle.description: The title of the contribution request.

date.description: The date the contribution was made. Should be a server timestamp.
The date the expense was incurred. Should be a server timestamp.

accessCode.description: The numeric access code for the user.

LogEntry.title: LogEntry
LogEntry.description: Represents a log entry for an action performed in the system.

timestamp.description: The server timestamp when the action occurred.

user.description: The name of the user who performed the action.

action.description: A description of the action performed.

pwaLogoUrl.description: The URL for the PWA icon.

/contributions/{contributionId}.description: Stores individual contributions made by students for specific requests.

/logs/{logId}.description: Stores a log of all actions performed in the system.

/settings/app_settings.description: Stores global application settings as a singleton document.
